name: clawd-vibe
description: Clawd above the prompt: dances with a headset while Spotify plays, cheers when a turn finishes, reads along as you type, gets bored, idles during a conversation, sleeps otherwise.

statusFile.title: Spotify status file
statusFile.description: Optional: without it Clawd works but never dances to music. Full path of the JSON file the Spotify watcher writes (Windows example: C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\clawd-vibe\.clawd-spotify.json). From WSL use the /mnt/c/... form of the same path.

autostart.title: Start the watcher at every Windows logon
autostart.description: Windows only. Creates a hidden scheduled task named 'Clawd Spotify Watch' that runs the watcher whenever you log in. Leave off to start it yourself.

sleepAfterSeconds.title: Seconds of silence before Clawd stops vibing
sleepAfterSeconds.description: How long the music must be off before the dance ends.

boredAfterSeconds.title: Seconds of quiet before Clawd gets bored
boredAfterSeconds.description: How long a conversation can sit idle before Clawd starts tapping his foot and yawning. 0 turns it off.
